text:
Avery: Thanks everyone — quick post-all-hands recap and a place to drop clarifications/owners. I pasted slides and links below. Please add any follow-ups.

Sam: Good session. Two quick asks: 1) who owns the Dedicated GA customer comms? 2) timeline for SLAs? 

Priya: Re: roadmap detail — Dedicated GA is still target Q3, SLA beta in Q4. I'm following up with legal on contract language.

Marco: For Dedicated rollout playbook, see https://redwood.ai/internal/dedicated-playbook (internal). I'll upload the canary checklist later today. 

Leah: Sales needs a short FAQ we can share with prospects. Who can own that? 

Priya: @Leah I can draft a one-pager by EOD Thursday. Will include: eligibility, pricing model, and typical lead times.

Jordan: Quick UX ask — can we get sample console screenshots for the FAQ? I can mock early tomorrow. 

Marco: Putting a small task on myself to add screenshots to the playbook. Will do after the canary checklist is up. 

Kai: Ops question from the huddle — what are the SLOs we're committing to for latency on Dedicated? We discussed targets but need concrete numbers for docs.

Sam: Target example: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 200ms for standard batch configs. We should mark these as 'target' not contractual until SLA beta completes.

Avery: Action list (please react with :white_check_mark: when done):
- [ ] Priya: Draft Dedicated one-pager for Sales (due Thu EOD)
- [ ] Marco: Publish canary checklist + console screenshots to playbook (due Fri noon)
- [ ] Jordan: UX mocks for FAQ (due Thu morning)
- [ ] Kai + Eng Infra: Formalize SLO numbers and add to docs (due Mon)
- [ ] Taylor: Coordinate internal all-hands follow-up email with links (due Wed)

Taylor: I'll send the follow-up email Wed morning and include the FAQ link and playbook pointers. 

Leah: Thanks — will queue the FAQ in our sales enablement deck once Priya's one-pager lands.

Priya: Note on pricing: initial Dedicated commitments will be negotiated with Sales; Finance is fine with a tiered reserved model. I'll loop in @Leah and @Finance in the doc.

Avery: Quick edits to the shared links: slides https://redwood.ai/slides/all-hands-2026, recording https://redwood.ai/recordings/ah-2026. If anyone can't access ping me.

ops-bot: Deploy: canary-playbook.md updated by Marco at 2678901305. 

Marco: Uploaded checklist and started a short 'how-to' snippet:
```
# how to run a canary
redwood rollout --env dedicated-canary --model v1.2 --traffic 5%
```

Kai: FYI we'll need a brief runbook for oncall if a Dedicated node degrades — adding that to eng-sre board. 

Sam: One more high-level ask: let's capture the customer segments we think will buy Dedicated first (SaaS platforms with >50k monthly MAUs, finance, healthcare). Priya/Leah to refine.

Avery: If anything else pops up from the Q&A that we missed, drop it here. I'll consolidate and add owners then update the action tracker. Appreciate the quick turns on this. :sparkles:
